post.description: Attachment writes require the management permission for their scope: settings for installation, manage_organization for an organization, configure for project/route/toolset, and keys for an API key. Scope and project ownership are checked again during the write.

delete.description: Attachment writes require the management permission for their scope: settings for installation, manage_organization for an organization, configure for project/route/toolset, and keys for an API key. Scope and project ownership are checked again during the write.

put.description: Attachment writes require the management permission for their scope: settings for installation, manage_organization for an organization, configure for project/route/toolset, and keys for an API key. Scope and project ownership are checked again during the write.

get.summary: Preview the guardrails attached to a route and API key
get.description: Inspect the installed serving release without evaluating content or dispatching. Compatibility only covers the selected static surface and mode. Request-dependent features, provider eligibility and fallback routes are not checked.

parameters.name: route_id
parameters.description: ID of a route in the serving release.

parameters.name: api_key_id
parameters.description: ID of an API key in the same project as the route.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: A serving operation on the route, such as generation.

parameters.name: surface
parameters.description: A request surface or dialect for the operation, such as openai-chat.

parameters.name: retains_output
parameters.description: Check provider-retained output compatibility for OpenAI Responses.

404.description: Route or key not found or not visible

post.description: Run a bounded set of synthetic guardrail fixtures against two pinned revisions of one policy. Only unary input and output entries with deterministic built-in evaluators run, and the report carries no fixture or transformed text.

200.description: Fixture run completed, including any failed candidate assertions

422.description: Invalid, oversized or unsupported fixture run

409.description: Credential is referenced by a retained definition

stale.description: True when a newer published release exists than the one inspected.

partial_visibility.description: True for any caller without installation-wide read access, regardless of which entries apply.

static_compatible.description: Whether the entire chain passed the selected static guardrail checks. Omitted for scoped callers.

entries.description: Visible entries in relative serving order.
